name: save-boot-14-choice-mktinn-diag
description: #168 attempt 1 (diagnostic; to be replaced by the acceptance check). Boot the generated save harness/saves/disc1-mktinn.json (mktinn, Wall Market's inn, field ID 0xC7 per ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID; triangle 0, x 0x7FFF, progress 6, Cloud alone), load as save-boot-1-load does, then 60 frames with no input. Checks the field ID and field mode. Reports load_done, the model count and, for field models 1-3 the sign of their PosX and PosY minus the player's (model 0): which way the inn's NPCs (the innkeeper's ask, the choice to reach) lie from the load point. Only signs and small counts leave.

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): the field ID.

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): 2 in a settled field.

model_count.description: g_FieldState (0x8009ABF4) + 0x28 modelCount (s16 as u16; confirmed #112, fieldModelCount).
